verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for an agent/workflow framework like Mastra, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of documented workflow or automation versioning, review gates, or rollback. The only nearby items are adjacent: 'versioned datasets' are for evaluation data, 'workflows your team can inspect' covers inspection rather than version history, and scoring runs before production is evals rather than rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
